item.title: Over 2,000 tonnes of waste disposed outside collection time in St Pauls Bay
item.description: In 2024, the Cleansing and Maintenance Department collected 2,041 tonnes of garbage that was disposed of outside of collection time in Malta's biggest locality

item.title: The good, the bad and the electoral manoeuvres
item.description: When you juxtapose the squandering of so many millions on a vanity project with much more crucial sectors where the money could be better spent, it makes you wonder if the priority of all politicians is simply to remain in power, no matter the cost
